import os
os.environ['HF_HOME'] = '/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache'
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET'] = '1'
os.environ['HF_ENDPOINT'] = 'https://hf-mirror.com'
os.environ['REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE'] = '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt'
os.environ['SSL_CERT_FILE'] = '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt'

import random
from datasets import load_dataset, Dataset

print('Loading C4 (first shard only)...', flush=True)
ds = load_dataset('allenai/c4', 'en', split='train', streaming=True)

print('Collecting 6000 samples with >=50 words...', flush=True)
samples = []
count = 0
for ex in ds:
    count += 1
    if count % 1000 == 0:
        print(f'  scanned {count}, collected {len(samples)}', flush=True)
    words = ex['text'].split()
    if len(words) >= 50:
        samples.append({'text': ex['text']})
    if len(samples) >= 6000:
        break
    if count >= 30000:
        break

print(f'Collected {len(samples)} valid samples from {count} scanned', flush=True)

random.seed(42)
random.shuffle(samples)

train_samples = samples[:4500]
eval_samples = samples[4500:5000]
prompt_samples_src = samples[5000:6000]

prompts = []
for s in prompt_samples_src:
    words = s['text'].split()
    if len(words) >= 64:
        prompts.append({'text': ' '.join(words[:64])})
    if len(prompts) >= 500:
        break

print(f'Train: {len(train_samples)}, Eval: {len(eval_samples)}, Prompts: {len(prompts)}', flush=True)

out_dir = 'data/c4_5k'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
